_note: Additional Drive folders to crawl for a district, merged with whatever asddo.html links. Some districts publish across more than one folder and the state page links only one of them, so a district can look complete while half its booths sit somewhere else. Booths are deduplicated by (constituency, part) with the newest generation timestamp winning, so listing an overlapping folder is safe — it can only add.
_howToFind: District NIC site, or a folder shared directly by the district office. Check it against scripts/reconcile.mjs before and after adding.

KOLAR.why: Correct 145-Mulbagal folder (264 booths, S10_145_* PDFs, dated 12-08-2026). The KOLAR NIC page links a stale/empty Mulbagal folder (1TLCtL2W6BJkmpeS-CWvQEp67SHwKrHX-, 0 files), so a page-only crawl drops AC 145 entirely. Folder verified accessible with 264 booths.

BELGAUM.why: Second Belagavi folder, one directory per constituency (01-Nippani … 18-Ramdurg). Crawled and merged: it contributed 0 new booths — all 1,323 of its files duplicate booths already found, at older timestamps. Kept because it costs one folder walk and would pick up anything the district adds there later. Belgaum's 47.7% shortfall against the CEO's count is therefore NOT a crawl gap: both published folders together hold only ~3,000 of Belagavi's ~3,900 booths.

Third Belagavi folder, one directory per constituency with July dates in the names ("09-Gokak ASDDO List 21.07.26", "18-Ramdurg ASDD List as on 24.07.2026"), 2,828 documents. Crawled and merged: contributed 0 new booths. With all three folders walked Belgaum still resolves to 3,464 booth PDFs, unchanged — the folders share the same underlying Drive objects rather than holding different booths.

_finding: Belgaum was investigated across three folders and none adds coverage. Its 47.7% shortfall tracks the age of its own lists, not a crawl gap: median generation date 31/07 against a CEO count current to 08/08. The same holds for Bidar (28/07, -37.2%) and Davangere (30/07, -10.5%), while every district publishing from 02/08 onward reconciles within a few percent. Those districts need to republish; there is nothing to find.
